name: webflow-zendesk-reviewer
description: Read, triage, and safely update Webflow Marketplace Zendesk tickets through the governed production MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Review Webflow Marketplace Zendesk tickets safely.
interface.longDescription: Use the production Webflow Zendesk MCP to read current ticket evidence, reconcile review-state claims with the bounded App Review MCP, draft or perform explicitly approved ticket updates, and return receipt-grade readback.
defaultPrompt: Read this Webflow Zendesk ticket and summarize the current requester need.
Triage this Marketplace support issue using current Zendesk and App Review evidence.
Draft a safe Zendesk reply for review without sending it.
